name: mobile-screen-design
description: Manual-only mobile screen design pass, invoked with /mobile-screen-design. Reviews or builds any mobile app screen in two passes: a defect pass (overlay contrast, media style-consistency, icon axes, mutable state in copy, decision order, action grouping, label/accessibility splits) then a flow pass (scroll context, sticky actions, common-case presets). Rules are graded by evidence strength against Apple HIG, Material, WCAG, and NN/g.
